EV-000001

First autocorrelation constant C1, upper bound · Autocorrelation inequalities · status current

Definition

C1 = inf over nonnegative f supported on [-1/4,1/4] with positive integral of max_t (f*f)(t) / (int f)^2. Entries record the best upper bound (smallest ratio attained by an explicit f).

C_1=\inf_{f\ge0,\ \operatorname{supp}f\subseteq[-\frac14,\frac14]}\frac{\max_t (f*f)(t)}{(\int f)^2}

Domain: nonnegative functions on [-1/4,1/4]. Normalisation: dimensionless ratio. Direction: min.
